summary.tldr: Requires the Minister of the Environment to develop a national strategy on environmental racism and environmental justice, and to report to Parliament on it.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of the Environment to develop a national strategy to advance environmental justice and to assess, prevent and address environmental racism.

Requires the Minister to consult with interested persons, bodies, organisations, communities, other ministers, governments in Canada and Indigenous communities, and to align the strategy with the federal Indigenous rights framework.
Requires the strategy to include a study on links between race, socio-economic status and environmental risk, plus information on where environmental hazards are located.

Allows the strategy to include changes to federal laws, policies and programmes, community involvement in environmental policy-making, compensation, and health data from communities near environmental hazards.
Requires the Minister to table the strategy in Parliament within two years, publish it on the Department of the Environment website, and report every five years on the strategy’s effectiveness.
